arabic text: AA DEKH MERE GAZI,/nUNCHA HAI ALAM TERA
english translation text: COME LOOK ABBAS,/nYOUR FLAG IS RAISED HIGH

arabic text: DIL SINE ME JAB TAK HAI BHULEGA NA GHAM TERA
english translation text: UP UNTIL THE TIME I LIVE, I WON’T FORGET YOUR GRIEF

arabic text: ZAINAB KI DUWA BANKAR IK WAQT WO AAYENGA\nHAR GHAR ME SAJA HOGA, ABBAS ALAM TERA
english translation text: WITH THE HELP OF ZAINAB’S DUA, THE DAY WILL COME\nEVERY HOUSE WILL HAVE YOUR ALAM

arabic text: AJATI HAI ZEHRA BHI ZAINAB BHI ZIYARAT KO\nJAB AATH MUHARAM KO UTH TA HAI ALAM TERA
english translation text: BIBI ZAINAB AND BIBI ZAHRA BOTH COME TO DO YOUR ZIARAT\nWHEN ON THE 8TH MUHARRAM, YOUR ALAM IS RAISED HIGH

arabic text: TABUT JAB UTH TA HAI SHABBIR KA AY GAZI\nTABUT KE AGE BHI CHALTA HAI ALAM TERA
english translation text: WHEN THE TABUT OF SHABBIR IS HELD O ABBAS\nTHE TABUT IS LED BY YOUR ALAM

arabic text: WO KON SE SADME THE SHEH TOOT GAYE JIS SE\nIK DARD THA ZAINAB KA AUR DOOSRA GHAM TERA
english translation text: WHAT WAS THE GRIEF THAT BROKE HUSSAIN?\nONE WAS THE GRIEF WAS OF ZAINAB AND THE OTHER WAS YOURS

arabic text: PARCHAM KA PHARERA THA YA AAS THI ZAINAB KI\nZAINAB KE KALEJE SE GHAM KAISE HO KAM TERA
english translation text: WAS IT THE FLAG OF YOUR ALAM OR WAS IT THE WISH OF ZAINAB?\nHOW CAN THE GRIEFBE LESSENED FROM BIBI ZAINAB’S HEART

arabic text: ZAINAB KI TO SANSO PE HE NAAM RAKAM TERA\nBAZAR ME ZINDAAN ME DARBAR ME HAR LAMHA
english translation text: IN THE BAZAAR, IN THE PRISON, IN THE COURTYARD, EVERY MOMENT\nZAINAB HAD YOUR NAME ON HER LIPS

arabic text: JAB BEH GAYA SAB PAANI TAB AAS TERI TOOTI\nTHA SINE KE ANDARIYA MASHKIZE ME DAM TERA
english translation text: WHEN ALL THE WATER WAS SPILLED, ALL YOUR HOPES BROKE\nWAS YOUR HEART IN THE FLASK OR WAS IT IN YOUR CHEST?
